slides.title: Three nations talk in Tehran
slides.image_prompt: Three empty chairs around a round wooden table with a single olive branch in the middle, evening light through tall windows
slides.label: WORLD
points: WHAT HAPPENED
Saudi, Pakistani and Turkish officials held talks in Tehran.
WHY IT MATTERS
They aim to stop new Iran–Israel–US fighting; no deal yet.
FOR YOU
Little changes today; Egypt also okayed military help for Saudi Arabia.

slides.title: Lula wins a fourth term
slides.image_prompt: A green and yellow ballot box on a marble step at dusk, a single gavel lying beside it, modernist columns in the background
slides.label: POLITICS
points: WHAT HAPPENED
Lula beat Flávio Bolsonaro 51.8% to 48.2% in Brazil's runoff.
WHY IT MATTERS
Bolsonaro refuses to concede and seeks to annul the result.
FOR YOU
Lula's new term runs 2027–2030; watch Bolsonaro's bid to annul the vote.
slides.body: Lula beat Flávio Bolsonaro 51.8% to 48.2% in Brazil's runoff. Bolsonaro refuses to concede and seeks to annul the result. Lula's new term runs 2027–2030; watch Bolsonaro's bid to annul the vote.

slides.title: A ceasefire to let aid in
slides.image_prompt: A line of white aid boxes on an empty country road at dawn, a white flag fluttering on a fence post, calm river in the distance
slides.label: WORLD
points: WHAT HAPPENED
A local ceasefire began around occupied Oleshky, southern Ukraine.
WHY IT MATTERS
Aid can enter, residents can leave; both sides observe it.
FOR YOU
Brokered by Melania Trump, it runs until week's end; strikes continue elsewhere.
slides.body: A local ceasefire began around occupied Oleshky, southern Ukraine. Aid can enter, residents can leave; both sides observe it. Brokered by Melania Trump, it runs until week's end; strikes continue elsewhere.

caption:
🗳️ Israel votes in a neck-and-neck race: turnout is the highest at midday since 1977. Exit polls come after 20:00 GMT, but a clear winner could take weeks.
🕊️ Saudi, Pakistani and Turkish officials held talks in Tehran to prevent new fighting. No deal yet.
📈 Anthropic, maker of Claude, filed for a Nasdaq IPO under the ticker ANT. Shares could trade as soon as November.
🇧🇷 Lula wins a fourth term in Brazil, 51.8% to 48.2%. Bolsonaro won't concede.
🚚 A local ceasefire around Oleshky, Ukraine, lets aid in and residents out until the end of the week.
